accepted_claims: Certified adaptive interval/implicit material can avoid a fixed-pitch discretization floor on bounded cases when every material cell has sound outward bounds and all decisive critical events/stopping witnesses are separately certified.

The task-local exact-rational controls preserve an exact 1/1000000 material web, exact tangency, complete removal, split material and retrace idempotence without binary-float, epsilon or fixed-depth predicate authority.

Adaptive refinement alone does not supply a generic exact equality decision: the exact 1/3 control stays strictly inside a positive-width dyadic cell at every finite bisection depth unless the event is injected/certified separately.
PB-007-01 and PB-007-02 therefore remain decisive for required tangential/multiple/singular and coupled phase-sensitive cases; the candidate is not a total general fallback.
RB-016-03 and RB-016-04 remain output-side blockers: exact adaptive material retention does not by itself qualify native micro-feature preservation or singular/exact-zero engineering output.
open_claims: PB-007-01: unconditional finite exact decisions for required tangential/multiple/singular transcendental equality events remain open.
PB-007-02: a full exact constructive route for general coupled helical/spindle-feed/eccentric event geometry remains open.
RB-016-03: native STEP preservation of certified positive micro-features remains unqualified.
RB-016-04: exact-zero contact/touching-cavity/singular-pinch output profile and independent-consumer behaviour remain unqualified.
Practical adaptive-cell resource growth and default production viability remain unqualified.
PO-08, MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject promotion of adaptive implicit material to a total general fallback
reject global epsilon or binary-float decisive predicates
reject fixed pitch or maximum subdivision depth as correctness authority
reject unresolved cells being coerced to material/removal success
reject numeric error compensating topology or deleting positive material
reject cell-width threshold as exact equality decision
reject promotion of PB-007 blocked equality/motion classes into certified coverage
reject independent phase coverage for correlated spindle/feed motion
reject loss of the exact 1/1000000 micro-web

review.disposition: negative candidate result: retain certified adaptive interval/implicit material as a bounded provider/accelerator after independent event and finite-progress certification; reject it as the total general fallback
review.downstream_release: MC-026 may consume this negative candidate evidence while preserving all inherited blockers; MC-025 does not release MC-B or authorize native implementation

downstream_invalidations: A change to MC-008 arithmetic/event termination semantics invalidates the bounded admission and equality-refinement conclusions.
A future reviewed resolution of PB-007-01 or PB-007-02 may change the general-fallback assessment but must preserve this negative result as historical evidence.
A changed MC-016 output/profile conclusion invalidates only the affected output-side classification and may not promote adaptive material cells into STEP authority.
Any downstream implementation that treats fixed depth, epsilon, timeout or unresolved cells as success invalidates its MC-025 use.
